note: The 100% notice, raised by the count: kind `usage.hours_out`, **one** per person and period. The 80% one from before is still there.

notifications.title: You are out of recorded hours
notifications.body: You have used all of your recorded hours, so the note taker will not join new meetings. A meeting that is recording now will finish. Your notes, transcripts and exports stay as they are.

notifications.title: Most of your recorded hours are used
notifications.body: You have used 4 of your 5 recorded hours. When they run out the note taker will not join new meetings.
